text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20 cm across. It holds about 35-40 almonds and a small pile of spinach leaves with a few shreds of carrot.

Almonds: at about 1.2 g each, 35 almonds weigh roughly 42 g. At about 6 kcal per gram, that is around 250 kcal. Counting them in the photo gives about 38, so I'll use 45 g and roughly 260 kcal.

Spinach: about 30 g at 23 kcal per 100 g is roughly 7 kcal. The carrot adds about 3 g and 1 kcal.

Total: about 78 g of food and about 270 kcal.
